title: Every 28 Days the AI Dreams of Soft Skin and Burning Stars: Scaffolding AI Agents with Hormones and Emotions

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning a 'femaleness' score to hormonally-informed generated system prompts using a HuggingFace Gender-Classification transformer model, and using TF-IDF keyword analysis to identify cultural stereotypes embedded within simulated menstrual cycle phases.
